svg.title: Counter-based RNG quality
svg.desc: Avalanche matrix, serial correlation and pair chi-square for the counter-based random generator.
svg.text: Path-key hash: mean bit-flip probability 0.5000, KS D 0.59e-3 < 1.33e-3 critical
20000 trials x 96 input bits; worst of 6144 cells: 4.5 standard errors (Bonferroni p = 0.05)
A: flipping any one input bit should flip each output bit with probability 1/2 (strict avalanche); cells are coloured by deviation in standard errors
√(1/(4 x trials)). The worst cell has Bonferroni p = 0.05 over 6144 cells: borderline, consistent with chance but worth repeating with more trials.
B: consecutive-pixel streams (u_i, u_i+1) binned 16x16 give chi-square near 255 if independent; the shaded band is the 95% interval of
chi-square(255). C: autocorrelation of the stream over 2^20 draws against the ± 1.96/√(N) band.
Counter-based design: every draw is a pure function of (seed, pixel, sample, depth, dim), so megakernel and wavefront consume identical random numbers
regardless of execution order; these tests probe the quality of that mapping.
